name: Prince Che
strengths: Che brings true 305-pound mass to occupy double teams and free linebackers.
Che can still push the pocket when he wins early with hands.
Che holds the point versus the run and does not get washed easily.
weaknesses: Che still needs more consistent first-step suddenness to become a weekly interior pass-rush threat.
comparison: Che comps to Vita Vea — thick 6-3 / 305 interior who occupies doubles, pushes the pocket, and holds the point with mass.
projection: Che projects as a Year 2 SEC starter on the interior (rotation snaps Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC defensive tackle — the space-eating disruptor who occupies doubles and pushes the pocket.
schemeFit: Che fits White’s odd front as a nose/3T who two-gaps, occupies, and creates second-level clean-up.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-04 from On3 profile Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Prince Che is a 4-star DL · listed 6-3 / 305 · Thomas County Central (Thomasville, GA) (GA) · open-board Florida target.
angle: Lead with Thomas County Central mass/occupy on soph Hudl; Florida priority interior.
